sections.heading: One strategic partner across your transformation
sections.body:
Linkfields is an AI-driven technology, engineering and advisory company, headquartered in South Africa with a global delivery footprint. Through our integrated service portfolios, we empower enterprises to accelerate digital transformation and modernise, run, analyse, secure and scale their operations. Combining deep industry expertise, proprietary software and reusable delivery IP, we accelerate time-to-market, optimise costs and deliver measurable business outcomes.

We also help organisations design, build, operate and scale Global Capability Centres (GCCs) through flexible engagement models, including Build–Operate–Transfer (BOT), enabling innovation, operational excellence and sustainable growth.

sections.heading: We lead with *outcomes*, not offerings
sections.description: Every play starts from a customer problem. Our five portfolios and Linkfields software sit behind each one.

plays.title: AI Code Assurance
plays.trigger: AI-generated code increases delivery speed and assurance risk.
plays.outcome: Quality and security gates across CI/CD for AI-written change.

plays.title: Modernisation & Programme Assurance
plays.trigger: Complex migration and customisation create regression and integration risk.
plays.outcome: Migration readiness, automated regression, integration rebuild and security validation.
plays.ip: Linkworks, Modernisation & Integration Toolkit, testoriumz, Release Assurance Packs

plays.title: Regulated Cyber Readiness
plays.trigger: Regulated industries need continuous evidence, not point-in-time reports.
plays.outcome: Continuous exposure validation, control mapping and remediation evidence.

plays.title: Intelligent Operations
plays.trigger: Cost-to-serve pressure creates demand for process intelligence and automation.
plays.outcome: Discover, redesign and automate work across process and customer channels.
plays.ip: Linkworks, Intelligent Workflow Automation Framework, testoriumz, Cyber-Safe Delivery

plays.title: Capability Centres with Embedded IP
plays.trigger: Organisations need scalable delivery capacity with stronger governance and automation.
